title: Relic Stats: ARAM Mayhem
description:
Ever wondered how much an ARAM: Mayhem augment has actually done for you? [b]Relic Stats: ARAM Mayhem[/b] tracks every augment (rune) and every enemy hex during a run and shows the result right in its tooltip.

It adds a [b]Stats[/b] box showing damage dealt, healing, Block, Energy, cards drawn or added, powers gained, extra gold and more. Every stat shows [b]this combat[/b] first and the [b]total for the run[/b] second.

[b]Currently tracking about 360 of 424 augments and 67 of 148 enemy hexes in detail.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic tracking[/b]: no setup. Pick up an augment and its stats start counting.
[*] [b]This combat + total[/b]: per-fight and whole-run numbers. Augments that only act once at the start or end of combat show a total only.
[*] [b]Augments and enemy hexes[/b]: hover an enemy hex to see what it did to you (healing, Block, powers, status cards like Dazed).
[*] [b]Real numbers[/b]: bonus damage and Block are adjusted for Weak, Vulnerable, Slippery and similar effects, and percentage augments such as Heavy Hitter show their live bonus.
[*] [b]Persistent across saves[/b]: stats are saved with your run and restored when you continue.
[*] [b]Zero gameplay impact[/b]: an information overlay only. It never changes gameplay, card rewards or RNG.
[*] [b]Optional expansions[/b]: ARAM: Mayhem: Extra Expansion Pack and ARAM Mayhem: Watcher Pack are tracked too if you have them. Skip them and everything else still works.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[b]Via Steam Workshop (recommended)[/b]
[list]
[*] Subscribe to this mod, [b]Relic Stats[/b] and [b]ARAM: Mayhem[/b] (both are required).
[*] Optionally subscribe to the Extra Expansion Pack and the Watcher Pack.
[*] Start a run and hover an augment or enemy hex. Stats begin tracking immediately.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bug reports[/h2]
Please report problems in the [b]Comments[/b] section below and say which augment or hex it was. Include your log file if you can:
[list]
[*] Windows: %APPDATA%/SlayTheSpire2/logs
[/list]
You can also add me on Discord: [b]hgiang[/b].

[hr][/hr]

changeNote: Dual Wield/First Aid Kit/Big Knife/Solid Time stats trimmed; Blossom Blade now counts teammate healing; new stats for Jeweled Gauntlet (moves repeated), Goldrend (gold lost), Mystery (cards transformed), Apotheosis (cards downgraded).
